hook: An AI fire nozzle at a Chinese ski resort kept spraying *flames on a sign*, soaking a food stall
caption:
At the Wanlong ski resort in Hebei, China, an AI camera fire system kept hosing down a food stall on November 19.
Reports say it aimed at the animated flames on the stall's digital sign. Some reports say heat from a nearby grill first set off the alarm.
No one was hurt, but the stall had to close for a cleanup.

Would you trust an AI to decide what counts as a fire?
